name: Ho2O3 bixbyite, 293 K
citation: E. N. Maslen, V. A. Streltsov and N. Ishizawa. A synchrotron X-ray study of the electron density in C-type rare earth oxides. Acta Crystallographica Section B 52 (1996), 414-422.
recommendation: ordered experimental source candidate; native FEFF validation pending
method: Experimental single-crystal X-ray structure; this unchanged deposited Ho2O3 CIF is the Mo K-alpha (0.71073 angstrom) data block as0696a. The paper also reports synchrotron measurements, which must not be confused with this specific deposited block.
synthesis_conditions: Synthetic single crystal; exact growth conditions not independently verified here.
notes: COD source block as0696a, supplied originally by IUCr Journals.
Both inequivalent Ho sites retained; normalized site populations are derived from expanded multiplicities, not the per-path FEFF degeneracy.

The crystallographic model is an ordered trivalent reference. FEFF L3 EXAFS paths require experimental validation and do not establish 4f multiplet structure, mixed valence, white-line intensity, calibrated S02, or absolute coordination number. No electronic-state or magnetic accuracy is implied by crystallographic agreement.
All variable coordinates and the unit cell are from this exact downloaded source; no element substitution, coordinate replacement, cell rescaling or symmetrization was written to the CIF.
The raw CIF omits occupancies; parser assumes full occupancy. This is not an explicit occupancy measurement.
scientific_warnings: The crystallographic model is an ordered trivalent reference. FEFF L3 EXAFS paths require experimental validation and do not establish 4f multiplet structure, mixed valence, white-line intensity, calibrated S02, or absolute coordination number. No electronic-state or magnetic accuracy is implied by crystallographic agreement.
measurement_conditions_evidence: Original publisher abstract reports T=293 K for the structures; the CIF itself has no temperature tag. Pressure is not numerically specified.
